subject: Request to Cancel May 3 Technical Briefing — Raintree
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@raintree.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@raintree.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood technical briefing — proposed dates

Hi Neha and Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. The core product team here at Raintree wanted a short technical briefing focused on inference performance and deployment options so they can evaluate resource needs for a Q3 pilot.

We'd like to schedule a 45–60 minute technical briefing (slides + live Q&A). Proposed windows:
- Monday, May 3, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tuesday, May 4, 14:00–15:00 PT

Heads up: a few of our execs are traveling the week of May 3–7, so if one of those times doesn't work I can propose an alternate later in May. Please let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Also attaching the short internal kickoff doc so you know who will attend.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Product Lead, Integrations
Raintree Health

Attachments: Raintree_kickoff_notes.docx (docx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@raintree.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood technical briefing — proposed dates

Hi Alicia,

Thanks — May 3 at 10:00 PT works for our engineers. I've penciled it in and will send a formal invite with the demo deck attached.

Agenda (proposed):
- 10:00–10:10: quick intros and goals
- 10:10–10:35: technical briefing (architecture, latency/cost tradeoffs, deployment options)
- 10:35–10:55: live Q&A (hooks for KV cache / multi-tenant inference)
- 10:55–11:00: next steps / action items

I've attached the short deck we'll run through — it's focused on inference economics and deployment patterns. If you want us to include procurement or security folks explicitly, please add them to the invite.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: demo-deck-redwood.pdf (slides)

From: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@raintree.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@raintree.com>, Raintree Procurement <procurement@raintree.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood technical briefing — proposed dates

Neha —

Quick update from our side: leadership has just reprioritized Q2/Q3 roadmap to focus headcount on mobile UX and billing integrations. That means the inference/LLM pilot is being deprioritized for the moment and we need to pull back on scheduling new technical briefings.

Can we cancel the May 3 session for now? We still want to keep the relationship warm but won't have the bandwidth to evaluate a pilot until later this year. If you have an asynchronous version of the briefing or a short recording we can circulate internally, that would be helpful. Also copying procurement in case there are any outstanding paperwork questions.

Apologies for the late change — it's a product-level decision and not a reflection on Redwood.

Thanks,
Tom Weaver
Head of Product Operations
Raintree Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@raintree.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@raintree.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood technical briefing — proposed dates

Tom —

Totally understand and thanks for the heads up. A couple quick options so we can keep momentum without a live session:

1) I can share a 20-minute recorded tech briefing and a short one-page summary of deployment patterns you can pass to execs.
2) We can keep the May 3 slot as "office hours" (30 minutes) and only invite the small set of engineers who aren't impacted by the reprioritization. Cancelable, of course.
3) If procurement has outstanding SOW or contract questions, we can close those proactively (no technical commitment required) — saves work down the road.

If it helps, we can also offer a limited pilot credit so you can run a perf sanity check later in Q3 without reapproval. Happy to tailor.

Which of the above would be most useful this quarter?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@raintree.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@raintree.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood technical briefing — proposed dates

Tom / Alicia —

Thanks for the transparency — we appreciate the roadmap constraints and can absolutely pause the live briefing. Per Ben's suggestions, we'll do the following so Raintree has materials to keep the conversation warm internally: 

- I'll share a 20-minute recorded technical briefing tailored to the agenda we agreed, plus the one-page deployment summary. Link attached.
- We'll keep the May 3 calendar hold tentative and I'll mark it as "canceled" on our side; happy to re-open when you have capacity (I'll follow up in early Sept to check timing).
- I'll also flag a small pilot credit (internal note: DEAL-8721 credit proposal) so procurement has a placeholder if you want to preserve budget runway. No signatures required now.

If procurement does want the SOW draft closed out regardless, Monica can push that through — Monica, please advise if we should send a clean copy to procurement for signature or just park until they ask.

Thanks again — speak soon and wishing the team a smooth roadmap transition.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments / Links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ExampleRecordedBriefing (recording), https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_demo_assets (assets), demo-deck-redwood.pdf (slides)
